description: Collision-induced absorption cross-sections of O2's pairs, on vacuum wavelengths (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.c and R08.T4.d, Karman et al. 2018's A and B bands), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs cross-sections from the fetched sources named here, which are not committed. Each table's rows are [nm, sigma at each of temperaturesK], m5 a molecule pair, whose absorption coefficient is sigma n_A n_B. Reduced values; the citations are in NOTICE's Data section.

pairs.terms: HITRAN states that its database and compilations are free (hitran.org/faq) and asks for its edition's article and the original sources to be cited (hitran.org/citepolicy); it states no licence: reduced values with their citations, the raw file not committed (decision-composition section 5)
pairs.reduction: The main file's sets and the theory file's (labelled 2018:), on vacuum wavelengths 1e7/nu. Each 1 nm bin, [nm - 0.5, nm + 0.5), takes the first of references 54 (Finkenzeller and Volkamer 2022, 297-500 nm at 223, 263 and 293 K, with reference 32's 203 K set below them), 32 (Thalman and Volkamer 2013, 335-654 nm at 203-293 K), 2018:27 (Karman et al. 2018, the B band 675.4-703.9 nm and the A band 746.2-781.1 nm at 206-346 K), 30 (Spiering et al. 2011, the B band's, 671-704 nm at 293 K) and 4 (Tran et al. 2006, the A band's, 723-794 nm at 296 K) with a set covering it whole: at each of those sets' temperatures the mean of its points in the bin, linear in T between them and held beyond, converted from cm5 to m5 and written to 6 significant figures. A bin no set covers (654-671, 704-723 and 794-800 nm) is 0, and a mean below zero, the measurements' noise, is written as 0. Measured over 206-287 K, where every double-transition bin lies between two of the measurements' sets and every B- and A-band bin within Karman et al.'s; Spiering et al.'s 672-675 nm and Tran et al.'s 733-746 nm, which Karman et al.'s sets do not cover whole, are held at their one temperature.
